# Ethan Qiu — Now

> Live "now" page for Ethan Qiu (software engineer, Toronto), regenerated hourly
> from public GitHub contributions and anonymous ActivityWatch coding-app totals. Almost nothing is hand-written:
> projects and stack are derived from live data. JSON is the source of truth;
> the markdown and this index are renders.

## Pages

- [Now (markdown)](https://now.ethanqiu.ca/now.md): availability, projects, this week's coding activity, stack
- [Now (JSON)](https://now.ethanqiu.ca/now.json): the full snapshot, structured

## Tools (machine-readable API, regenerated hourly)

- [Tool manifest](https://now.ethanqiu.ca/api): lists every tool, its description, and data URL
- [get_identity](https://now.ethanqiu.ca/api/identity): name, headline, location, links
- [get_availability](https://now.ethanqiu.ca/api/availability): whether Ethan is open to opportunities
- [get_projects](https://now.ethanqiu.ca/api/projects): personal and contributed GitHub repos, including organization work; private projects anonymized
- [get_stack](https://now.ethanqiu.ca/api/stack): languages derived from personal and contributed public GitHub repos
- [get_activity](https://now.ethanqiu.ca/api/activity): public GitHub contributions and coding-app time, last 7 UTC days
- [get_coding](https://now.ethanqiu.ca/api/coding): anonymous active time in Orca and VS Code, split by app and date; last sync timestamp included
- [get_summary](https://now.ethanqiu.ca/api/summary): short prose summary of the last 7 days of coding
- [get_contributions](https://now.ethanqiu.ca/api/contributions): filtered GitHub contribution calendar (daily counts, past year), totals + streaks

## Other resources

- [Portfolio](https://ethanqiu.ca): projects, experience, and contact info
- [Resume (PDF)](https://ethanqiu.ca/resume.pdf): canonical resume
